EVIN.description: You flood chats with media at 2 AM and start half the conversations. Your friends wake up to a wall of stickers, photos, and voice notes.
EVIN.fun_fact: You combine peak expressiveness with late-night energy — the rarest combo of creative + nocturnal.

EVID.description: You're the life of every group chat — always starting conversations, always sending something interesting. Morning, noon, or (reasonable) night.
EVID.fun_fact: You're the friend everyone expects to see online first. Your chats never have awkward silences.

EVRN.description: Your friends send a message and you reply with a voice note, 3 stickers, and a paragraph — at midnight. You react big and you react late.
EVRN.fun_fact: You rarely start conversations but when you jump in, you make up for lost time with media-rich replies.

EVRD.description: You reply to everything with maximum effort — long messages, perfect stickers, the right GIF. You're the group chat's biggest hype person.
EVRD.fun_fact: Your reply game is unmatched. You don't just respond — you perform.

EMIN.description: Stickers, GIFs, and voice notes do the talking for you. You keep it short but visually loud, especially after midnight.
EMIN.fun_fact: You've mastered the art of saying everything with almost no words — just perfectly timed media.

EMID.description: You kick off conversations with a sticker or a quick voice note. Efficient, expressive, and always available during the day.
EMID.fun_fact: You're the person who sends a single sticker that somehow says more than a paragraph could.

EMRN.description: You haunt the chat at odd hours with perfectly chosen reactions — a sticker here, a GIF there. Few words, maximum impact.
EMRN.fun_fact: Your sticker collection tells a story your words never will. Silent but expressive.

EMRD.description: You keep the energy up with quick reactions and well-placed media. Not many words, but every sticker lands perfectly.
EMRD.fun_fact: You're the barometer of the group chat — your reactions set the tone.

TVIN.description: You write essays at 3 AM and start deep conversations when everyone else is asleep. Your messages deserve their own scroll bar.
TVIN.fun_fact: Your average message length is in the top tier. You don't text — you compose.

TVID.description: You start thoughtful conversations with long, detailed messages. No stickers needed — your words carry all the weight.
TVID.fun_fact: You're the friend people go to for real advice. Your texts read like letters.

TVRN.description: When you finally reply, it's a wall of text that addresses every point. You process slowly but respond thoroughly — usually at night.
TVRN.fun_fact: Your reply-to-message ratio is low, but your words-per-reply ratio is off the charts.

TVRD.description: You respond to messages with structured, detailed replies. If texting were a job, you'd be the senior consultant.
TVRD.fun_fact: You probably re-read your messages before sending. Quality over speed, always.

TMIN.description: You start conversations with a single 'hey' at 1 AM. Minimal words, maximal mystery. No media, no fluff.
TMIN.fun_fact: You're proof that a two-letter message can carry more weight than a paragraph.

TMID.description: You say what needs to be said and nothing more. Every message is purposeful. You're the person who actually answers questions directly.
TMID.fun_fact: Your texting style is optimized for clarity. No wasted characters.

TMRN.description: You reply with 'k' at 2 AM after leaving everyone on read for hours. Minimal effort, maximum intrigue.
TMRN.fun_fact: You've elevated the art of the one-word reply to a personality trait.

TMRD.description: Short replies, reasonable hours, and you let others drive the conversation. You're here, you're present, but you're efficient about it.
TMRD.fun_fact: You probably have the fastest average response time because your messages are so short.
